#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys,json,hashlib,importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import test_command_exec_parity as driver
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original',Path(__file__).with_name('invalid-probe-v1.py'));m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
i=sys.argv.index('--case');case=sys.argv[i+1];del sys.argv[i:i+2]
base={k:v for k,v in m.P.items() if k in ['h121:true','h121:false','h121:reference']}
needed=[] if case=='valid' else [case]
if case=='nested_missing':needed+=['missing']
if 'cycle' in case:needed+=['cycle_a','cycle_b']
for name in needed:base['h121:'+name]=m.P['h121:'+name]
m.P=base
# Test only the requested invalid graph after positive controls; preserve all raw results.
original=m.program
def program():
 ops=original()
 if case=='valid':return ops
 # Put the requested graph last so any abrupt cycle failure retains preceding controls.
 labels={'true','false','reference','absent',case}
 return [o for o in ops if o['op']!='cmd' or o['label'].split('-')[0] in labels or not any(o['label'].startswith(n+'-') for n in needed if n!=case)]
if __name__=='__main__':
 driver.corpus_module.predicate_selector_fixtures=lambda names:base
 driver.corpus_module.function_return_fixtures=lambda names:{'h121:pack':'scoreboard players set pack h121 17\n'}
 driver.corpus_module.groups=lambda:[('Predicate isolated graph probe',program())]
 build=Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--work-dir')+1]);build.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 build.with_suffix('.declaration.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(case=case,predicates=base,script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),scope='separate fresh Java invalid graph diagnostic, not a native baseline'),indent=2)+'\n')
 driver.main()
